interface.shortDescription: Build and run AI methods from Codex with Pipelex.
interface.longDescription: Build and run AI methods from Codex with Pipelex. Skills design a method in MTHDS, prepare its inputs, run it, save it to your Pipelex account and wire it into your code, and a hook checks every .mthds edit. The hook and the Pipelex tools run on Node.js, which must be on your PATH. Export PIPELEX_API_KEY with a key from your console at app.pipelex.com; there is nothing else to install.
